claim: EngineCore.step schedules work, waits for executor results, drains aborts, then updates scheduler output.
AsyncLLM.generate receives per-request output collector items and aborts on cancellation or generator exit.
The completion router delegates to the serving adapter and returns JSON or SSE according to the response.
NixlConnector aliases the pull/READ connector in the inspected revision.
NIXL transfer results distinguish finished receives from failed receives and retain handles while release is unsafe.
The pull worker initiates nonblocking reads and tracks producer heartbeat/expiry state.
The scheduler handles remote-KV receive failure before publishing reusable cache blocks and leaving the blocked waiting state.
Dynamo defers early decode-side engine abort until the first generation output to avoid aborting during an in-flight NIXL transfer.
Dynamo example launches Qwen3-0.6B on separate prefill/decode GPUs with NIXL roles and eager execution.
Ordinary dispatch returns five items and combine three; deferred epilogues instead return event wrappers with data-producing wait hooks.
EventOverlap.current_stream_wait establishes a current-CUDA-stream wait and runs a registered hook once.
DeepEP correctness tests enumerate stream, alignment and precision variants, and use max(1, capacity minus rank) active tokens.
EP workspace requires total expert count divisible by rank count.
Combine epilogue accumulates activation values and writes returned top-k weights separately.
